face:
Use case: style-transfer. Supporting reference: approved Gemventure stone wall, preserve its blue-gray/slate/lavender material, dark-purple joints, broad matte softened geometric chamfers and extremely simple chunky shapes.
Create a production GAME WALL FACE TEXTURE, a rectangular edge-to-edge opaque texture, not a standalone wall object. Two staggered courses of very broad natural blocklike stones: three large front planes across each course, upper course shifted relative to lower. Front elevation only; no perspective top or side of a freestanding wall, no outside silhouette, no transparent margin. Broad slate-lavender planes with quiet intermediary bevel tones, slightly lighter top bevel and darker right bevel as in reference. Almost flat color with restrained soft transitions. Only a few dark-purple joints separating major masses, not every facet outlined. Six masses total, not many bricks. Not regular masonry: slightly unequal widths and broad angular softened stone contours. No cracks, grain, noise, rubble, bright highlights or small details.
SEAMLESS HORIZONTAL TILING: left and right canvas edges cut through the middle of continuous stone planes and match exactly in color and course level; no dark vertical border at either edge. One continuous course seam at half-height. Entire rectangle filled with opaque stone. Tile can continue upward/downward too. Landscape 3:1 aspect. No text, diagram, labels, watermark or background.
top:
Use case: style-transfer. Supporting reference: approved Gemventure stone wall. Create a production seamless TOP SURFACE material for the same wall, an opaque rectangular texture entirely filled edge to edge with large softly chamfered geometric blue-gray rock planes. Match the reference's light blue-gray top faces, muted intermediate blue-gray bevels, dark-purple sparse joints and matte finish. Orthographic plan view of the stone surface only, no freestanding object, no front wall elevation or perspective silhouette.
Only FOUR to SIX VERY LARGE broad irregular rectangular/polygonal rock masses, staggered and close fitting. Few broad facets. Softened geometric corners, not round pebbles. No gravel, small blocks, tiny facets, cracks, fine texture, white sheen or glow. Light upper left. Large quiet color fields, subtle transitions only as in approved reference.
This material will be clipped to the top rim of the game cave wall, so it must fill the whole canvas: no outside border, transparent margins, floor or background. Seamlessly tileable on all four edges: rock planes and joints continue across matching boundaries. Landscape 2:1 texture. No text or watermark.
